env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

cd wasi

# A wasip1-only file with a JSON-tagged struct: the JSONv2 companion
# must keep the wasip1 restriction in its file name. Splitting after
# "wasip1" would hand the companion to every wasm GOOS, including
# JavaScript builds whose original stays excluded.
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/data_wasip1_wasm.go
exists out/data_jsonv2_wasip1_wasm.go
! exists out/data_wasip1_jsonv2_wasm.go
exec grep -E 'jsontext' out/data_jsonv2_wasip1_wasm.go
! exec grep -E 'jsontext' out/data_wasip1_wasm.go

cd out
go build ./...
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
env GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm
go build ./...
env GOOS=$TESTGO_GOHOSTOS GOARCH=$TESTGO_GOHOSTARCH

# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

-- wasi/go.mod --
module example.com/wasiplat

go 1.27

-- wasi/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {
	println("host")
}

-- wasi/data_wasip1_wasm.lgo --
package main

type Data struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
	Count int32  `json:"count"`
}
